stories.headline: Unkernel and Trynix just transported computing to 2035
stories.summary: The Register highlights recent open-source software experiments, including Unkernel and Trynix, that reimagine traditional operating system and hypervisor architectures. Inspired by long-standing conceptual discussions on computing design, these projects explore radical alternatives to standard virtualization and software isolation layers.

stories.headline: Pensions and benefits services still down after 'cyber incident'
stories.summary: Online benefits and pensions services in the UK were taken offline following a cyber incident detected by the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP). Cyber security experts suspect the systems were targeted by hackers, prompting a preemptive shutdown to protect data, though the government has not yet confirmed the exact cause.

stories.headline: Quantum: 'Five years, that's all we got…'
stories.summary: At the SC supercomputing conference in Chicago, industry discussions highlighted ongoing progress in integrating quantum processors with classical high-performance computing (HPC) workflows and error-correction tools. However, experts noted that hardware error rates remain a fundamental bottleneck, estimating it will take at least five years before fault-tolerant systems can meaningfully outperform classical supercomputers.
